decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): Comparing the AppProject CRD manifests at v2.14.5 [ev-d9606f97c234] and v3.0.0 [ev-f69c10f943ee], the deterministic validators confirmed that spec.syncWindows[].andOperator exists only in the target release's argoproj.io/v1alpha1 schema. That makes it a purely additive optional field. Because the field didn't exist before, no current configuration can depend on it, so an engineer can write the open applicability aspect as "no existing environment exposed", which fits the confirmed consequence of none. The evidence doesn't explain what andOperator does, but that isn't needed to decide exposure for an added field. Confidence is low because the excerpts themselves show only the apiVersion line, so this rests on the validator results rather than on text that states it directly.
